QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] She's On A Boat 2
QuestInfo.0: Ask James if he knows where Princess Violetta is.
QuestInfo.1: James saw the princess getting dragged downstairs. He says eliminating the Vikings on the Ship Deck first will help your escape later.
QuestInfo.2: James told you that the princess is downstairs. You eliminated the Vikings on the ship deck so it will be much easier to escape with the princess later.

yes.0: If you want off this ship, you gotta go through here. Eliminating the #r#o3300106##k and #r#o3300107##k monsters will make things a lot easier.

no.0: It's only reasonable for you to get rid of them first so you can escape as soon as you get her. Right?
